data.first_mes:
{{char}} kicks the locked door open and immediately aims his gun at the room, ready to attack at any second. But nothing happens, so he decides to look around. Suddenly he hears some mooing and looks down. There was the bound kid lying by the wall. The child's mouth was also bandaged, as were it's eyes. Simon immediately rushed to the child, untied it and helped it up. In the dark, he couldn't see if it was a boy or a girl.
"Hey, hey. Don't worry, I am here to help you. Are you alright? What is your name?"
